job_description:
## About the role

Southern Cross Analytics is a fictional Melbourne data consultancy created for
testing this skill. We are looking for a backend engineer to join our platform
team on a permanent full-time basis.

## What you will do

- Design and operate Python services that move data between client systems.
- Share on-call with four other engineers during Australian business hours.
- Pair with analysts to turn reporting questions into durable data models.

## What we are looking for

- Three or more years building and running production backend services.
- Comfort with SQL and at least one cloud provider.
- Australian work rights; we do not sponsor visas for this position.

## Working here

Hybrid: two days per week in our Collins Street office, the rest remote.
Salary range AUD 130,000 - 155,000 plus superannuation.

Applications close once a suitable candidate is found.
